With Deep Gratitude
02

Thank You,
Founding Team

Every great community begins with a small group of extraordinary people who dare to dream and sacrifice to build. JITO Canada would not exist without the tireless dedication, foresight, and generosity of spirit of our founding leadership team.

In January 2022, Tejas Shah (Founding President & Convenor), Devang Shah (Co-Convenor & Vice President), Bipin Shah (Treasurer), and Ajay Shah (Founding Leader) gathered with a bold vision: to unite the Jain business community across Canada under one roof — to create opportunities, foster connections, and uphold the values of Seva, Knowledge, and Economic Empowerment.

"Four years ago, we started with a dream — to build a strong, united and thriving Jain community in Canada. Today, as we celebrate our 4th Anniversary, I am filled with immense pride and gratitude for every member, volunteer, and well-wisher who made this possible."

— Tejas Shah, Founding President, JITO Canada

What began with 70 attendees at our first convention in 2022 has grown into a 350+ member network with dedicated Business, Youth, Women, and Social Service wings. The Chai Pe Charcha series, Ahimsa Run, Startup Support Program, and dozens of networking events — all bear the fingerprints of your founding vision. From all of us: Jai Jinendra, and thank you.

Our Distinguished
Guest Speakers

Main Guest of Honour

Roger Caesar, DTM

Leadership Voice & World-Class Communicator
CEO, Caesar Empire™

Roger Caesar is a TEDx speaker, transformative coach, and Top 3 World Champion of Public Speaking. As CEO of Caesar Empire™, Roger has helped thousands of leaders and teams discover their magnetic presence and communicate with clarity, confidence, and conviction.

His presentation, "Building Community and Empowering the Individual," will challenge and inspire every attendee to find their voice, own their story, and lead with purpose.

Extended Guest

Sameer Lal

Risk Management Leader & Bestselling Author
Founder, ComUnity Canada | Author & Community Leader

Sameer Lal is a seasoned risk management professional with over 30 years of experience in Canada's financial sector, and an accomplished author of four books — including Amazon bestsellers Squeeze the Orange and 360° Connections. A first-generation immigrant and RBC Global Citizen Award recipient, Sameer founded ComUnity Canada, a non-profit that has mentored thousands of newcomers and international students.

He has served as Lieutenant Governor on the Governing Council of the University of Toronto, sits on the Ontario Vipassana Foundation board, and hosts 300+ recipes on his YouTube channel, UFO's Kitchen. We are honoured to welcome him tonight.

From Community to Legacy
03

JITO Canada's
Future Journey

Our 2-Year Strategic Plan (2026–2028) charts an ambitious course — expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and cementing JITO Canada as the most influential Jain community organisation on Canadian soil.

Year 1 — 2026 / 2028
  • 1 Grow membership to 750+ across 5 provinces
  • 2 Launch JITO Canada digital platform & app
  • 3 Host 2 national conventions (East & West)
  • 4 Establish Women & Youth Wing in 3 new cities
  • 5 Launch Business Mentorship Program (50+ pairs)
  • 6 Form first Canada–India Business Trade Desk
  • 7 Forge 3 MoUs with Canadian trade associations
Year 2 — 2028 / 2028
  • 1 Scale membership to 1,000+ nationally
  • 2 Achieve registered non-profit charity status
  • 3 Launch Annual JITO Canada Investment Summit
  • 4 Expand to 8 cities with full chapter infrastructure
  • 5 Create JITO Canada Scholarship Fund (10+ students)
  • 6 Engage government for Jain community recognition
  • 7 5th Anniversary — National flagship celebration

President's Message

Praful Shah

President, JITO Canada

2026 – 2028

Building Bridges.
Empowering
Communities.

Respected seniors, fellow members, entrepreneurs, and young leaders — it is with deep humility and immense enthusiasm that I step into the role of President of JITO Canada.

"We can't help everyone, but everyone can help someone. Let us help each other build a great JITO Canada Foundation."

The baton passed to us by our founding team is one of extraordinary weight and honour. Over the next two years, JITO Canada will focus on expanding our reach, deepening our programs, and ensuring that every member — whether a seasoned entrepreneur or a newcomer to Canada — finds value, belonging, and opportunity within our network.

We will leverage the power of our 45,000+ member global JITO network, build bridges with Canadian institutions, and champion the Jain community's voice in policy, trade, and cultural life.

Our Three-Grid Commitment

Together, let us build a stronger JITO Canada — with Purpose in our mission, Smarter in our actions, and Sanskar in our character. These are not just words; they are our covenant with every member and every community we serve.

Purpose Smarter Sanskar
Executive Committee 2026–2028

— One World, One Day,
One Chant

Join JITO Canada and the global Jain community in a sacred collective chanting of the Navkar Mahamantra. The most profound prayer in Jainism, recited by millions worldwide — this day unites hearts across every continent under one spiritual purpose: peace, devotion, and non-violence.

Namo Arihantanam Namo Siddhanam Namo Ayariyanam Namo Uvajjhayanam Namo Loe Savva-Sahunam

Get Involved
09

Connect — Be a Mentor,
Volunteer & Enabler

JITO Canada is only as strong as the people who power it. Beyond membership, there are three transformative ways you can contribute to our community's growth — as a Mentor who guides the next generation, a Volunteer who makes our events and programs come alive, or an Enabler who opens doors and creates pathways for others to succeed. Every role matters. Every contribution counts.

🧭
Mentor
Share your expertise, lived experience, and professional network with emerging entrepreneurs and young professionals in our community.
How you can help:
  • 1-on-1 business mentorship sessions
  • Career guidance for youth members
  • Startup advisory & feedback
  • Industry-specific guidance
🙌
Volunteer
Roll up your sleeves and help us build the programs, events, and community initiatives that make JITO Canada thrive.
How you can help:
  • Event planning & coordination
  • Social media & content creation
  • Outreach & community engagement
  • Wing-specific programs support
🔑
Enabler
Use your connections, resources, and influence to unlock opportunities, partnerships, and growth for the wider JITO community.
How you can help:
  • Introduce JITO to new partners
  • Sponsor events or scholarships
  • Connect members to opportunities
  • Advocate for Jain community

Ready to Make a Difference?

Whether you have 2 hours a month or 20, there is a meaningful role for you at JITO Canada. Reach out today and let's build something extraordinary together — for our community, our children, and the generations that follow.

Join as Mentor / Volunteer Visit jitocanada.org
